query.description: A weapon name as the user wrote it: partial, misspelled, or exact. A minimum length is enforced by a precondition, not here, so a too-short query refuses (exit 11) rather than being rejected as malformed (exit 10).

weapon_class.description: Optional. Restrict the search to one weapon class, e.g. 'Katana' or 'Colossal Sword'. Use it to narrow an ambiguous query, never to guess at one.
